findings.description: Year field accepts '0000' because the regex /^\d{4}$/ matches it; validation should exclude years 0 or 1 as unrealistic. Move the range check before parsing or use a stricter regex.
If no projects exist, the grid renders empty with no message. Add a placeholder card (like MessagesPage does) to clarify the state.

parseErrorMessage assumes error.response?.data?.message exists, but some API errors may return messages in a different structure. Test with backend to confirm message extraction works for all error cases.
